svg.title: Share with v6 addresses, by four sources
svg.desc: Four panels, one per source, each the share on v6 by month: all traffic at Cloudflare with automated requests included, requests at Cloudflare, Google users, APNIC users able to use v6.
svg.text: Share with v6 addresses, by four sources
